background: OP Financial Group is Finland's largest financial group, a cooperative owned by its member banks and their customers, funded by Finnish deposits and covered bonds and lending to Finnish households and companies, with a large insurance arm.
synthesis: The group is rated AA- on average across two of the three main agencies, both on a stable outlook; the third withdrew its rating on 4 Dec 2018. The ratios are strong across the board against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 21.2%, leverage of 11.3% and LCR of 191% are all in the top quarter, and NSFR of 130% is above the peer median. Leverage has risen 0.8 points since 30 Jun 2025 and the rest has been flat, and nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. One of the best-capitalised banking groups in Europe, with a cooperative structure under which the member banks are jointly liable.
